items.source: Application-specific view classes will typically extend from either AbstractRssFeedView or AbstractAtomFeedView instead of from this class.
items.translation: 特定于应用程序的视图类通常会从AbstractRssFeedView或AbstractAtomFeedView扩展，而不是从该类扩展。

items.source:
Default is an empty implementation. Subclasses can override this method
to add meta fields such as title, link description, etc.
items.translation: 默认是一个空实现。子类可以重写此方法以添加元字段，例如标题、链接描述等。

items.source: Create a new feed to hold the entries.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 Feed 来存放条目。

items.source: feed - the feed being populated
items.translation: feed - 正在填充的 feed

items.source: request - in case we need locale etc. Shouldn't look at attributes.
items.translation: request - 如果需要区域设置等信息。不应查看属性。

items.source: NOTE: As of Spring 4.1, this is based on the com.rometools variant of ROME, version 1.5. Please upgrade your build dependency.
items.translation: 注意：自 Spring 4.1 起，此功能基于 `com.rometools` 变体的 ROME 库，版本为 1.5。请升级您的构建依赖。

items.source: Thanks to Jettro Coenradie and Sergio Bossa for the original feed view prototype!
items.translation: 感谢 Jettro Coenradie 和 Sergio Bossa 提供的原始 Feed 视图原型！

items.source:
The first step will be preparing the request: In the JSP case,
this would mean setting model objects as request attributes.
The second step will be the actual rendering of the view,
for example including the JSP via a RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 第一步是准备请求：在 JSP 的情况下，这意味着将模型对象设置为请求属性。第二步是视图的实际渲染，例如通过 RequestDispatcher 包含 JSP。

items.source:
Note that the passed-in HTTP response is just supposed to be used for
setting cookies or other HTTP headers. The built feed itself will automatically
get written to the response after this method returns.
items.translation: 注意，传入的 HTTP 响应仅用于设置 Cookie 或其他 HTTP 标头。内置的 Feed 将在本方法返回后自动写入响应中。

items.source: Description copied from class: AbstractView
items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractView

items.source: since 7.0. Libraries or applications can provide their own View class or perform rendering in web handlers directly.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，库或应用程序可以提供自己的 `View` 类，或在 Web 处理器中直接执行渲染。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to build feed entries, given the model.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，以便根据模型构建 Feed 条目。

items.source: Populate the feed metadata (title, link, description, etc.).
items.translation: 填充馈送元数据（标题、链接、描述等）。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to actually render the view.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法才能实际渲染视图。

items.source: renderMergedOutputModel in class AbstractView
items.translation: `renderMergedOutputModel` 类中的 `AbstractView`

items.source: model - combined output Map (never null), with dynamic values taking precedence over static attributes
items.translation: model - 组合输出 Map（永不null），动态值优先于静态属性。

items.source: Exception - if rendering failed
items.translation: Exception - 如果渲染失败

items.translation: Exception - 构建期间发生的任何异常

items.translation: model - 模型，如果元数据信息必须从中填充则使用它。

items.translation: feed - 要添加条目的源
